# middmonitor_maintenance_window (Resource)

A period during which alerts on one target are suppressed. The API has no update for these, so any change replaces the window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Suppress alerts on a check during a planned upgrade.
resource "middmonitor_maintenance_window" "upgrade" {
  name        = "Kernel upgrade"
  target_type = "service"
  target_id   = middmonitor_service.api_health.id
  starts_at   = "2026-09-15T22:00:00Z"
  ends_at     = "2026-09-16T02:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) End of the window, RFC3339.
- `name` (String) Why the window exists, shown on the suppressed alert.
- `starts_at` (String) Start of the window, RFC3339.
- `target_id` (Number) ID of the service or host whose alerts are suppressed.
- `target_type` (String) `service` or `host`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Maintenance window ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import middmonitor_maintenance_window.example 42
```
